title: Mono destinations, sans stop name
description: Destination headsigns switch to mono/tabular numerals so they sit visually flush with the mono ETA column; the stop name stays sans at weight 800. Mono becomes the board's "data" register (clock, ETAs, destinations) while sans is reserved for the place name.

changes.intent: Move destination text into the mono/tabular register shared with the clock and ETA columns, unifying rows around a data-table feel.
Keep the stop name sans and heavy so it stays the one piece of prose-register text on the header.
